title: ceterach cordatum var. capense
intro: Ceterach cordatum var. capense, commonly known as the Karroo rock fern, is a type of fern found in the Western Cape Province of South Africa. It is believed to have various health benefits, including being used to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Ceterach cordatum var. capense include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and the reduction of inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to confirm their exact composition and effects.
